title: Thank every tipper
summary: Fast, personal thanks makes people tip again.
steps: Thank tippers by name within a few seconds.
Match the thanks to the tip: a quick line for small tips, a bigger moment for big ones.
Mention the goal progress so others want to join in.
prompts: + Thank you so much! That got us halfway there 💕
+ You're a star, thank you! Who's next to help?

title: Big tippers (whales)
summary: Make big tippers feel seen without ignoring the rest of the room.
steps: Give a bigger, personal thank-you and remember their name next stream.
Offer a small choice (next pose, next song) as a thank-you.
Keep the rest of the room involved so it doesn't feel like a private show.
tips: We chase spenders, not headcount. A smaller room of real tippers beats a big room of lurkers.

title: Moving fans to OF after rapport
summary: Funnel only when a viewer shows interest, using approved, platform-safe wording.
steps: Build rapport first. Never open with a link or a hard sell.
Wait for a sign of interest (asking for more, private questions).
Let curiosity do the work. Hold back on cam so OF is the place to see more.

title: Pushy requests
summary: Stay friendly, stay in persona, and redirect. Use mute or ban when needed.
steps: Redirect politely to the goal or the menu.
If they keep pushing, ignore and keep the stream moving.
Mute or ban anything on the banned-terms list straight away.
Safety or privacy concern? Screenshot it and raise an Incident Flag right away.
